_about: Recorded answer for ops-api job_trace (INT-34). SIMULATED: the trace run on a copy of the rows DSP-10's hand trace of SWF-26979 recorded on 19 Oct 2026 (secureworks-projects dispatch/verify/evidence/20261019-chain-trace-SWF-26979.md), with made-up row ids. Not a production read. Regenerate only when the contract changes, and say why in the PR.

reasons.read_failed: A read behind this link failed, so its state is not known. Never read as missing.
reasons.job_not_accepted: The job has no acceptance and is not in an open (past quoted) status.
reasons.no_accepted_quote: The job is accepted or open, but no sent quote or frozen scope revision is on record.
reasons.accepted_without_frozen_revision: A quote was sent and the job is accepted, but no frozen scope revision marks what was accepted.
reasons.no_material_lines: No Dispatch material line is on the job.
reasons.lines_not_reviewed: At least one material line is still not_reviewed.
reasons.lines_not_on_order: At least one material line marked to_order is on no purchase order.
reasons.no_purchase_orders: No live purchase order is on the job.
reasons.legacy_po: A purchase order on the job was not made by Dispatch (no source): a retyped order, not linked to lines and never sent through Dispatch.
reasons.order_not_sent: A Dispatch purchase order on the job has no sent order email.
reasons.order_send_unknown: A Dispatch order email is sending or send_unknown: whether it reached the supplier is not known.
reasons.no_supplier_bills: No supplier bill is placed on the job and none is known to be waiting for it.
reasons.bill_not_placed: A supplier bill known to belong to the job (named by its purchase order, or suggested for it) has no materials fact on the job.
reasons.bill_linked_no_fact: Our Xero copy links a supplier bill to the job, but no materials fact counts it.
reasons.no_job_work_order: The job has no job work order (kind job).
reasons.work_order_draft: The job work order is a draft: not approved, not sealed.
reasons.work_order_not_sealed: The job work order is approved but carries no seal hash.
reasons.no_crew_lines: No crew pay line is on the job.
reasons.line_not_on_work_order: A crew line on the job is not stamped onto the job work order.
reasons.crew_bill_held: A crew line waits on office review (awaiting, queried or rejected), so its invoice is held out of Xero.
reasons.crew_bill_not_in_xero: A crew invoice with lines on the job has no Xero bill.
reasons.no_customer_invoice: No customer invoice is on the job.
reasons.invoice_draft_only: The job's customer invoices are all drafts in Xero.
reasons.party_not_invoiced: A paying party on the job has no customer invoice of its own.
reasons.no_live_card_reading: The job card has no live reading (no live ledger generation).
reasons.h7_not_released: The H7 bill outcome reader is not on main (backend drafts #1129 and #1141), so the card shows no bill outcome yet.
